        <set-variable name="rdwrHostResolved" value="@{
          // returns "|" — the source is the header that supplied it, or
          // "gateway" / "fallback-value"; a hostname can never contain '|', so the split is safe.
          string cfgList = ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrTrueHostHeaderName", "") ?? "").Trim();
          string fb = ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrHostFallback", "") ?? "").Trim();
          string gateway = (context.Request.OriginalUrl.Host ?? "").Trim().TrimEnd('.').ToLower();
          string lc = cfgList.ToLower();
          bool off = cfgList.Length == 0 || lc == "-" || lc == "disabled" || lc == "off" || lc == "false" || lc == "none" || lc == "~" || lc == "##disabled##";
          string chosen = "";
          string source = "";
          if (!off)
          {
            foreach (string nameRaw in cfgList.Split(','))
            {
              string name = nameRaw.Trim();
              if (name.Length == 0) { continue; }
              string[] vals = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault(name, default(string[]));
              if (vals == null || vals.Length == 0 || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(vals[0])) { continue; }
              // a forwarding header may carry a list; the client's own hostname is the first element
              string v = vals[0].Split(',')[0].Trim();
              // reject a value that is not a bare hostname BEFORE the port is stripped: otherwise
              // "https://evil.example.com/p" would be cut at the scheme's colon and become "https"
              if (v.IndexOf('/') >= 0 || v.IndexOf('\\') >= 0 || v.IndexOf('?') >= 0
                  || v.IndexOf('@') >= 0 || v.IndexOf(' ') >= 0) { continue; }
              if (name.ToLower() == "forwarded")
              {
                // RFC 7239: for=...;host=example.com;proto=https
                string picked = "";
                foreach (string partRaw in v.Split(';'))
                {
                  string part = partRaw.Trim();
                  if (part.ToLower().StartsWith("host=")) { picked = part.Substring(5).Trim().Trim('"'); }
                }
                v = picked;
              }
              // drop the port, keeping an IPv6 literal intact
              if (v.StartsWith("[")) { int close = v.IndexOf(']'); if (close > 0) { v = v.Substring(0, close + 1); } }
              else { int colon = v.IndexOf(':'); if (colon > 0) { v = v.Substring(0, colon); } }
              v = v.Trim().TrimEnd('.').ToLower();
              // a header is client-supplied: never forward something that is not a hostname, and
              // never let a control character (CR, LF, TAB, DEL, ...) reach a header or a trace line
              bool ctl = false;
              for (int ci = 0; ci < v.Length; ci++) { if (v[ci] < (char)0x20 || v[ci] == (char)0x7f) { ctl = true; break; } }
              bool usable = !ctl && v.Length > 0 && v.Length <= 253
                            && v.IndexOf(' ') < 0 && v.IndexOf('/') < 0 && v.IndexOf('\\') < 0
                            && v.IndexOf('?') < 0 && v.IndexOf('@') < 0 && v.IndexOf(',') < 0;
              if (usable) { chosen = v; source = name.ToLower(); break; }
            }
          }
          if (chosen.Length == 0)
          {
            string fbl = fb.ToLower();
            bool fbGateway = fb.Length == 0 || fbl == "gateway" || fbl == "-" || fbl == "disabled" || fbl == "off" || fbl == "false" || fbl == "none" || fbl == "~" || fbl == "##disabled##";
            if (!fbGateway)
            {
              string v = fb.TrimEnd('.').ToLower();
              bool usable = v.Length > 0 && v.Length <= 253
                            && v.IndexOf(' ') < 0 && v.IndexOf('/') < 0 && v.IndexOf(':') < 0
                            && v.IndexOf('?') < 0 && v.IndexOf('@') < 0 && v.IndexOf(',') < 0;
              if (usable) { chosen = v; source = "fallback-value"; }
            }
            if (chosen.Length == 0) { chosen = gateway; source = "gateway"; }
          }
          return source + "|" + chosen;
        }" />

        <set-variable name="isTrustedInlineSource" value="@{
          try
          {
            string rawCfg = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("trustedInlineSourcesCfg", "");
            string cfg = (rawCfg ?? "").Trim();
            string lc = cfg.ToLower();
            // treat common tokens as DISABLED
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cfg) || lc == "-" || lc == "disabled" || lc == "off" || lc == "false" || lc == "none" || lc == "~" || lc == "##disabled##")
            {
              return false;
            }

            string clientIpStr = context.Request.IpAddress;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(clientIpStr)) { return false; }

            System.Net.IPAddress clientIp;
            if (!System.Net.IPAddress.TryParse(clientIpStr, out clientIp)) { return false; }

            bool anyMatch = false;
            string[] tokens = cfg.Split(',');
            foreach (string raw in tokens)
            {
              string token = (raw ?? "").Trim();
              if (token.Length == 0)
              {
                // skip
              }
              else if (token.Contains("/"))
              {
                string[] parts = token.Split('/');
                if (parts.Length == 2)
                {
                  System.Net.IPAddress netIp;
                  int prefix;
                  bool ok1 = System.Net.IPAddress.TryParse(parts[0].Trim(), out netIp);
                  bool ok2 = int.TryParse(parts[1].Trim(), out prefix);
                  if (ok1 && ok2)
                  {
                    int maxPrefix = (netIp.AddressFamily == System.Net.Sockets.AddressFamily.InterNetwork) ? 32 : 128;
                    if (prefix >= 0 && prefix <= maxPrefix)
                    {
                      byte[] ipBytes  = clientIp.GetAddressBytes();
                      byte[] netBytes = netIp.GetAddressBytes();

                      /* Families must match (no MapToIPv6 in APIM expressions) */
                      if (ipBytes.Length == netBytes.Length)
                      {
                        int fullBytes = prefix / 8;
                        int remBits   = prefix % 8;

                        bool match = true;
                        for (int i = 0; i < fullBytes; i++)
                        {
                          if (ipBytes[i] != netBytes[i]) { match = false; break; }
                        }

                        if (match && remBits > 0)
                        {
                          int idx = fullBytes;
                          byte mask = (byte)(0xFF << (8 - remBits));
                          if ((ipBytes[idx] & mask) != (netBytes[idx] & mask)) { match = false; }
                        }

                        if (match) { anyMatch = true; }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
              else
              {
                System.Net.IPAddress single;
                if (System.Net.IPAddress.TryParse(token, out single))
                {
                  if (clientIp.Equals(single)) { anyMatch = true; }
                }
              }
            }

            return anyMatch;
          }
          catch
          {
            return false;
          }
        }" />

            <set-variable name="rdwrTargetRaw" value="@{
              var path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path ?? "";
              // Strip API base-path prefix so SP sees the real client path
              var basePath = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrApiBasePath", "");
              if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath) && path.StartsWith(basePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
              {
                path = path.Substring(basePath.Length);
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) { path = "/"; }
              }
              var idx = path.IndexOf(";rev=");
              if (idx >= 0)
              {
                var slashIdx = path.IndexOf("/", idx);
                if (slashIdx >= 0)
                {
                  path = path.Substring(0, idx) + path.Substring(slashIdx);
                }
                else
                {
                  path = path.Substring(0, idx);
                }
              }
              // Escape a bare '%' in the PATH only (one not starting a %XX escape): the endpoint answers
              // 400 to it, which the connector treats as fail-open. Only what the endpoint refuses is
              // escaped; the query is sent raw, and the request to the backend is never changed.
              var pfix = new System.Text.StringBuilder(path.Length + 8);
              for (int pi = 0; pi < path.Length; pi++) {
                char pc = path[pi];
                if (pc == '%') {
                  bool okEsc = pi + 2 < path.Length
                    && ((path[pi+1] >= '0' && path[pi+1] <= '9') || (path[pi+1] >= 'a' && path[pi+1] <= 'f') || (path[pi+1] >= 'A' && path[pi+1] <= 'F'))
                    && ((path[pi+2] >= '0' && path[pi+2] <= '9') || (path[pi+2] >= 'a' && path[pi+2] <= 'f') || (path[pi+2] >= 'A' && path[pi+2] <= 'F'));
                  pfix.Append(okEsc ? "%" : "%25");
                } else { pfix.Append(pc); }
              }
              path = pfix.ToString();
              // path and query are kept exactly as the client sent them (no decode/re-encode) so the
              // inspection request line is no longer than the one API Management admitted
              var qs = context.Request.OriginalUrl.QueryString;
              return path + "\u0001" + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(qs) ? "" : qs);
            }" />
            
            <set-variable name="rdwrTargetDropped" value="@{
              string raw = (string)context.Variables["rdwrTargetRaw"];
              int sep = raw.IndexOf('\u0001');
              string path = raw.Substring(0, sep);
              string qs = raw.Substring(sep + 1);
              int budget = 8192 - (context.Request.Method ?? "GET").Length - 1 - 11;  // "METHOD target HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              int full = path.Length + qs.Length;
              if (full <= budget) { return 0; }
              int keepQs = budget - path.Length;
              if (keepQs < 0) { keepQs = 0; }                       // path alone is over budget: left whole
              if (keepQs > 0 && keepQs < qs.Length) {
                // do not split a %-escape: if the cut lands within %XX, back up to before the %
                for (int k = 0; k < 2 && keepQs > 0; k++) {
                  int pc = qs.LastIndexOf('%', keepQs - 1);
                  if (pc >= 0 && pc > keepQs - 3) { keepQs = pc; } else { break; }

            <set-variable name="rdwrFitDrop" value="@{
              var kept = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet(new string[] {
                "host","cookie","user-agent","referer","origin","authorization","content-type","content-length",
                "accept","accept-language","accept-encoding","x-forwarded-for","forwarded","x-real-ip","x-requested-with" });
              string cipHdr = ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("configuredHeaderNameForClientIp","##DISABLED##") ?? "").Trim().ToLower();
              if (cipHdr.Length > 0 && cipHdr != "##disabled##") { kept.Add(cipHdr); }
              int lines = 8;  // the connector eight x-rdwr-* lines, always sent
              // API Management refuses to modify these request headers (set-header throws), and it
              // frames/strips the connection-management ones on the outgoing inspection call itself,
              // so they are neither counted against the endpoint limits nor ever placed in the drop
              // list (a delete-slot on one would turn a normal request into a 500).
              var restricted = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet(new string[] {
                "connection","content-length","keep-alive","transfer-encoding","upgrade","te","trailer",
                "proxy-connection","proxy-authenticate","proxy-authorization","expect" });
              long bytes = 0;
              foreach (var kv in new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary {
                {"x-rdwr-app-id",(string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrAppId","") ?? ""},
                {"x-rdwr-api-key",(string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrApiKey","") ?? ""},
                {"x-rdwr-connector-ip",(string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("clientIpToSend","") ?? ""},
                {"x-rdwr-connector-port",context.Request.OriginalUrl.Port.ToString()},
                {"x-rdwr-connector-scheme",context.Request.OriginalUrl.Scheme ?? ""},
                {"x-rdwr-plugin-info",(string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pluginInfo","") ?? ""},
                {"x-rdwr-connector-proto","2"},{"x-rdwr-connector-stage","request"} }) {
                bytes += kv.Key.Length + (kv.Value ?? "").Length + 4;
              }
              var sizeByName = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary();
              var optional = new System.Collections.Generic.List();
              foreach (var kv in context.Request.Headers) {
                string n = (kv.Key ?? "").ToLower();
                if (n.StartsWith("x-rdwr-")) { continue; }  // the connector sets its own; a client cannot (reserved-header 403)
                if (restricted.Contains(n)) { continue; }   // API Management manages/strips these; never drop them
                string v = string.Join(",", kv.Value ?? new string[0]);
                int b = n.Length + v.Length + 4;
                lines += 1; bytes += b;
                if (!kept.Contains(n)) { sizeByName[n] = b; optional.Add(n); }
              }
              var drop = new System.Collections.Generic.List();
              foreach (var n in optional) {
